title: Setup → Branding saves, but the workspace name, accent colour and logo change nothing in the app
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-16** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, `/apps/setup/system/settings/branding`.
- **Steps:** set Organization name "HotCRM QA Org", Accent colour `#e11d48`, Logo URL `/_console/favicon.ico`; Save (200 "Settings saved"); reload; open the login page in a fresh browser.
- **Expected:** the page's description, "Organization name, logo, and accent colour."
- **Actual:** login page still "ObjectOS"; document title "Setup — ObjectOS"; CSS `--primary` unchanged (`215 19% 35%`); no logo anywhere. Logo URL also accepts `not a url` and `#e11d48` (type `url` input, no validation).
- **Evidence:** [`25-config-branding-after-save.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/25-config-branding-after-save.png), [`25-config-branding-effect-login.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/25-config-branding-effect-login.png), [`25-config-branding-effect-app.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/25-config-branding-effect-app.png).
- **class: a.** **Reach:** every deployment.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `service-settings` branding namespace → console theme / login shell.
- **Dedupe words:** branding not applied, accent colour no effect, logo url validation.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** of the branding settings, only `workspace_name` has a reader (`plugin-auth`, `auth-plugin.ts:1064`). Nothing passes the rest to the runtime config the console reads.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 2 hits in objectstack, 3 in objectui, none on point. **New.**
